sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [G]I would be, dear Savior, wholly Thine; Teach me how, teach me how;
[G]I would do Thy will, O Lord, not mine; Help [D7]me, help me now.
[G]Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, Wholly [D]Thine, this is my vow;
[G/D]Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, Wholly [D7]Thine, OLord, just now.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [G]What is worldly pleasure, wealth or fame,
[G]I will leave them all [D]for Thy dear Name,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [G]As I cast earth's transient joys behind,
[G]In Thy presence all [D]in all I find,
